title: Kissed Smoky Croatian Pork Risotto
description: A malty, dense, and romantic Croatian dish featuring shichimi-togarashi and smoke, this recipe is perfect for a special occasion, the combination of pork and risotto creates a hearty and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the pork shoulder with shichimi-togarashi and smoked paprika.
Heat the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the pork until browned on all sides.
Remove the pork from the pot and set it aside.
Add the Arborio rice to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the white wine to the pot and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Add 1/2 cup of warm chicken broth to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding the chicken broth in 1/2 cup increments, stirring constantly, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Return the pork to the pot and stir in the Grana Padano cheese.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and the top is lightly browned.
